explainBack.question: Why did Anthropic banning every linked account not stop the Mali surveillance project?
explainBack.answer: Because a provider's power ends at its own service. Anthropic can see activity on Claude accounts and revoke that access, but it cannot see or control what the actor does elsewhere. The Mali operators had already built a working surveillance workflow; once Claude access was cut, they rebuilt and deployed it locally on other models. The ban removed one tool, not the operation.
explainBack.expectedEvidence: P005 establishes visibility limited to the provider's own service; P003 and P006 report Axios's finding that the Mali system was deployed locally with other models after access was cut.
explainBack.assessment: The article's mechanism fully supports this causal answer in ordinary language; visibility, intervention and its boundary are each explicit.

unseenTransfer.scenario: A future headline reads: 'Chatbot helped hackers cripple a regional hospital network', citing only an AI provider's own transparency report describing blocked accounts that asked for intrusion scripts.
unseenTransfer.question: Using this article's method, how much of the headline does the provider report actually establish?
unseenTransfer.answer: Apply the four levels. The provider observed requests (level one) and perhaps an operating workflow if the accounts ran attack tooling through the model. It did not observe a completed harmful system inside the hospital, and it cannot observe real-world harm — only the hospital, incident responders or a public authority could confirm an outage and link it to those accounts. So the report supports 'provider blocked suspicious accounts', not 'chatbot crippled a hospital', unless independent investigators corroborate the last two levels.
unseenTransfer.expectedEvidence: P007 and P011 supply the four-level ladder and the rule that one level does not prove the next; P009 supplies the check on who made the claim (provider logs vs independent investigators vs public authority).
unseenTransfer.assessment: The mechanism transfers cleanly to this new domain with no extra assumptions, confirming genuine reusability.
